caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular wooden chest with an angled, slanted lid. The chest is brown, with varying shades that suggest the natural grain and texture of wood, giving it a weathered appearance. Metal bands, depicted in a dark metallic color, reinforce the edges of the lid and sides. These bands curve and are affixed with visible rivets, and two long metal straps run from the back corners over the top to the front, ending in curled, ornate tips. There is a large, decorative metal escutcheon in the center of the lid, also in dark metal, featuring a symmetrical, swirling pattern. A single metal strap fastens the lid to the front with an elaborate clasp. The front edges and corners of the chest are reinforced with more metal, including a large, horizontal hinge or bracket attached to the lower right corner of the chest and a matching vertical one on the left side. The background is a plain, light cream color with no other objects or details. In the lower right corner of the drawing, the artist's signature "Sam W. Pond Del - 850" is visible.
title: Conestoga Tool Box
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
